noseLength.raw: Nose length including tip is .848″ (may require single feeding)

Hammer Bullets: "g1-bc= .546"; the page says "Calculated from shot drops at 860y, 4200′ elevation, MV of 3400 fps.".

slowestTwist.raw: Minimum required twist rate is 1-10″ or faster

note: PDR drive band spacing is .200″ (recommend two drive bands in the case neck for concentricity) Tip length is .143″. Recommended use: Big Game Hunting. Form factor= .949. The product page also says: "This .308 caliber Hammer HBC™ was designed to be fully stable in the common factory barrel twist rate of 1-10″. This bullet offers a high bc value coupled with very high velocity potential that will be very hard for any bullet to match. All of this in a bullet designed for exceptional terminal performance for shots at very close range to very long range. No worries about your long range bullet not being able to perform if the unexpected close range shot appears." The product page also says: "AT THIS TIME TIPS ARE CONSUMER INSTALLED" The product page also says: "TIPPING BLOCK INCLUDED WITH EACH ORDER"
